provider_rules.evidence_note: NOAA defines the reporting day as 0000-2359 GMT and flags maxima derived from hourly or synoptic temperature samples with *. Apply only to retained source-days matching the original GSOD maximum within 0.051 C. The UTC reporting interval is known; exact sample times and completeness remain unverified. This is a sample maximum rather than a continuous 24-hour extreme.

Use original DMI max_temp_w_date from/to intervals for retained days matching the original values. Vestervig matches all 366 days in 2020; Nordby has 230 matching days among 231 available, beginning 2020-05-15. Midnight boundaries follow the explicit UTC offsets, including DST. The API from timestamp excludes midnight by 1 ms as a query convention; nominal measurement boundaries are midnight. Hourly checks distinguish the local day from a fixed 23 UTC cut on seven retained source-days.

ASTA hourly metadata and explicit time offsets specify fixed GMT+1. From cached January/July 2026 data, all 92 complete hourly windows reproduce the daily maximum for 00-24 CET; UTC calendar days match only 82. Apply only to the 5938 retained source-days from 2024-11-17 onward directly matching the published daily maximum. No older observations are assigned using this check; 2026 diagnostic observations are not added to the analysis.
